name: encoded_literal_scan
description: Find a literal you know the start and end of (marker ... closer) hidden in base64, base32, hex, rot13 or as UTF-16/UTF-32 text, in a file or memory image: every encoding at every byte phase, decoded without running anything. Only a decoded literal is reported (a marker with no literal is listed by offset alone). Whole result in out_dir; windows through start, length and budget_seconds.

path.description: The file or memory image to scan (read only)

marker.description: How the literal starts: 4 to 64 printable ASCII characters (a token prefix, a record's opening)

closer.description: How it ends (default "}"): 1 to 16 printable ASCII characters

max_body.description: Most characters between marker and closer (default 300)

encodings.description: Which of base64, base32, hex, rot13, wide (UTF-16/32 text); default all

out_dir.description: Where the whole result goes, inside the run directory and not under inputs/ (default work/<agent>/encoded_literal_scan)

start.description: First byte of a window, by where a hit begins (default 0)

length.description: How many bytes of the window (default: to the end)

budget_seconds.description: Stop at a chunk boundary after this long and say complete=false with next_start (default 90)

max_hits.description: Stop at a chunk boundary once this many marker hits are held (default 50000) and say where to go on: a marker that is everywhere is not a search

limit.description: Candidates shown in the answer (default 100); all are in the result file
